stemMarkdown: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 3 : 5. After 9 years, their ages will be in the ratio 42 : 64. What is A's present age (in years)?
solutionMarkdown: Let the present ages be $3x$ and $5x$. Then $\dfrac{3x + 9}{5x + 9} = \dfrac{42}{64}$. Cross-multiplying and solving gives $x = 11$, so A is $3 \times 11 = 33$ years old.
